signature: _run_setup_extract(proj_dir, work_dir, script_dir, is_incremental, resume, required_source_files, submodules, one_phase, plugin_config)
pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory containing the project source tree; work_dir is a writable directory for pipeline outputs; script_dir is an existing directory containing the FM-Agent scripts; is_incremental, resume, and one_phase are booleans; required_source_files, if not None, is a sequence of file paths relative to proj_dir; submodules, if not None, is a sequence of subdirectory paths within proj_dir; plugin_config, if not None, is a PluginConfig object whose stages may override the default pipeline stage behaviors
post_condition: Upon normal return, an up-to-date phases.json file exists at the expected path under work_dir, an engine_overview.txt and one phase_NN_types.txt file per phase number defined in phases.json exist under work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/, and each phase_NN_types.txt describes the types and invariants for the source files assigned to that phase in phases.json. If any of these required output files is absent from its expected location, the process exits with code 1 and emits a diagnostic message that enumerates the expected outputs.
